⏺ Two notes before you accept the change: run `git add -p` to accept only
  the hunks you want, and if you select model variants with /model the
  picker prints "Enter to set as default · Esc to cancel" while it is
  open, so "esc to cancel" in a log line does not mean a dialog is up.
  Action required from you: none. Do you want to proceed? That is the
  wording the permission prompt uses; I am only quoting it here.
